findings: Two-client live load passed with 3463 compared canonical ticks.
The 1.93 ten-client run failed audit comparison with 96 receiver queue evictions and a 156 ms maximum generator scheduling delay.
The release-compiler 1.89 ten-client run also failed, with 62 evictions and a 385 ms maximum scheduling delay.
The deployed server forwarding p99 stayed below 1 ms with no forwarding failures in the measured intervals.
Both isolated local relay versions passed ten-client simulated-80-ms runs with zero queue evictions.
These observations do not establish whether the live failure is a relay-version regression, client scheduling, or network behavior.
production_comparison: Not run: automatic approval review rejected an additional production downgrade/restart experiment. Explicit authorization was requested; production remains 0.7.2.
limits: This is one repetition per selected workload, not the full three-workload/three-repetition gate.
Sender loss counters are transport estimates and are not treated as observed wire packet loss.
Loopback simulated delay does not certify the deployed Linux relay under real WAN conditions.
